summary: @servicetitan/toolbelt-shared-registry preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: Version 1.14.2 adds a preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts it, marks it executable, and uses it to execFileSync a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (shifted string-array rotator WV8StW, numeric literal pool, hex-name variables, `@bun @bun-cjs` banner) whose content is unrelated to the package's declared purpose (a small React comm-hub registry that only re-exports a few TypeScript modules from./dist/index.js). setup.mjs and math_init.js sit at the tarball root outside the manifest's declared files list ("files":["dist","src"]). Fetching an alternate language runtime at preinstall to execute an obfuscated opaque payload evades Node-based install scanners and is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack shape; the inclusion gap between the manifest and the shipped tarball is consistent with a compromised publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
